Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 89.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 93.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 91.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 82.3%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 43.0%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Sign-in & account: Post-adoption sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; moving sign-in post-waiting hurt, while account sync hints and safety notices showed no clear effect.
Path selection: Headline updates (clarity and value proposition), spotlight layouts, and visual story stage redesigns won; checklist layouts and story scroll redesigns hurt, while hints and copy simplifications showed no clear effect.
Waiting room: Interactive waiting rooms, desktop visibility/readiness status checks, and spawn location hints won; progress trackers, timers, sound notifications, and compatibility screens showed no clear effect.
Adoption flow: Split photo upload previews with quality guides won; compact grids, guidelines banners, stamp redesigns, and fallback or multi-step inspection flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews, incentives, and layout customizations showed no clear effect.
Finish & placement: Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome redesigns, docking hints, and retrieval callouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions accuracy: Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive flow wins (such as placement verification screens and spawn placement flows) and overpredicted gains on severe flow failures (such as stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, multi-step inspection, and guided spawn stages).

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Spotlight Pick Friend Selection View
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection screen into a spotlight view highlighting personality traits and custom vs starter choices.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest funnel drop-off (68.9% conversion) with long median time (89s), indicating users struggle with companion selection.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Ideal Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a starter friend or prepare photos for a custom companion tailored to your workspace.

candidates.title: Pet Character Confirmation Stage
candidates.change: Insert a companion preview stage right after photo upload to confirm companion visual settings before certificate generation.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pet generation output failing or looking unexpected.

new_pet_character_preview.headline: Preview Your Companion
new_pet_character_preview.body: Check your companion look and traits before finalizing adoption.

candidates.title: Pre-Photo Sign-In Sequence
candidates.change: Move sign-in directly after companion picking and before photo upload so character choices are immediately attached to the account.
candidates.why: Support receives 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, making early account attachment critical.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Preparation Flow
candidates.change: Add a dedicated desktop launch verification step during waiting to prepare screen real estate before mascot spawn.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited pets failing to show on desktop or the app stalling at startup after onboarding.

new_launch_check.headline: Preparing Desktop Canvas
new_launch_check.body: Ensuring your companion has a safe screen position to spawn.

candidates.title: Path Choice Reassurance Note
candidates.change: Display a hint on path selection explaining that starter vs custom paths can be switched anytime later.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s (vs 8s median), showing a long tail of hesitant users.

choose_path.hint: You can add custom pets or change companion modes anytime later in app settings.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Overview Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen layout to highlight system tray controls and companion interaction shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support tickets show confusion post-onboarding on how to hide, summon, or talk to the pet.

home_welcome.text: Your pet is active on your desktop!
Use the system tray icon to hide, summon, or talk with your pet anytime.

candidates.title: Photo Generation Quality Advice Tip
candidates.change: Add clear image requirements hint on the photo upload screen explaining lighting and pose guidance.
candidates.why: Users report custom pet generation failing or rendering wrong output.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload well-lit front-facing photos with clear background contrast.

candidates.title: Account Pet Link Guarantee Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in screen hint to explicitly state that pets and items are bound to the cloud account.
candidates.why: Account pet sync/reset is the largest single issue in support tickets (8 emails).

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically syncs your adoption progress and custom companion data to your account.

candidates.title: Background Spawn Readiness Notification
candidates.change: Trigger a timely desktop notification when hatching completes while waiting in background.
candidates.why: Waiting stage median time is 201s with long mean times (2336s), leading to user dropoff or impatience.

waiting.body: Your companion is hatching in the background. We will alert you the moment it spawns!

candidates.title: First Day Desktop Welcome Note
candidates.change: Add an inviting welcome headline and action button on the final screen prompting the user's first desktop click.
candidates.why: 82.3% finish conversion leaves room to improve onboarding completion and initial engagement.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your New Workspace Buddy!
home_intro.body: Your companion is ready on your screen. Double-click your pet to start your first chat!
